questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All fans are lights.

No fan is a bulb.

Conclusions:

(I) No light is an bulb.

(II) No bulb is a fan.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e07d2c34fafffb5a60f5cfe65304b7060542660f14fcf2b3fe27d65936154c7c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No light is an bulb. - False (As their is no direct relation between light and bulb, maybe it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II) No bulb is a fan. - True ( No fan is a bulb . No bulb is a fan.Hence, it is True)

Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: In a row of 172 students facing north, Mr. Maxi is 21st from the right end. If Mr. Han is 61st to the left of Mr. Maxi, what is Mr. Han's position from the left end of the line?
questions.solution:
Total students = 172

Mr. Maxi = 21st from the right end

To find Maxi’s position from the left:

"Position from left"=172-21+1=152

 

So Mr. Maxi is 152nd from the left.

Mr. Han is 61st to the left of Mr. Maxi, 

"Mr.Han’s position"=152-61=91

 

Mr. Han is 91st from the left end.
Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: All 119 students in a class are standing in a straight line facing north. Tika is 20th from the right end while Vishnu is 29th from the left end. How many people stand between Tika and Vishnu?
questions.solution:
Let’s find their positions from the left first.**
Tika is 20th from the right in a line of 119 students.

"Position from left"=

119 - 20 + 1 = 100

So Tika is 100th from the left.

Vishnu is already 29th from the left.

"People between"

= (100-29) - 1 

= 71 - 1

= 70

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 781 752 642 105 864 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)

In how many of the given numbers is the third digit of a number a factor of the first digit as well as second digit of the same number?
questions.solution:
Given - (Left) 781 752 642 105 864 (Right)

Numbers is the third digit of a number a factor of the first digit as well as second digit of the same number.

1) 781 → digits: 7, 8, 1

Third digit = 1

1 divisible by both 7 and 8

2) 752 → digits: 7, 5, 2

3) 642 → digits: 6, 4, 2

Third digit = 2

2 divisible by 6 and 4

4) 105 → digits: 1, 0, 5

5) 864 → digits: 8, 6, 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
